dash.hint: Drag a panel header to reorder; layout is stored locally.
topbar.title: Heart Rate Pusher V1
win.cornerhint: Affects only the window frame (0 = square, max 24); in-page controls are unchanged. Win11 uses native DWM rounding (small/large tiers); Win10 clips by pixels.
win.fullscreenhint: F11 also toggles it; F5 reloads and F12 opens DevTools.
close.title: Close window
close.hint: Minimizing keeps heart rate and overlays running; exiting stops the whole app.
close.actionhint: You can switch back to "Ask every time" anytime.
close.unsavedhint: {n} setting form(s) are unsaved. Save them first?
net.failedhint: 30 attempts failed. Make sure the main app is still running and the port is free.
common.name: Name
safe.banner: Safe mode is active: auto-connect, detection, reconnect, OSC, system collection, and automatic pushes are suspended.
safe.entryhint: Suspends auto-connect, detection, reconnect, OSC, system collection, and automatic pushes. In normal mode, triple-press R within 1 second to enter.
quit.title: Confirm quit
crash.title: Engine crashed
crash.body: The engine exited unexpectedly. Restart the backend and the UI will reconnect automatically.
crash.retryfailbody: Several attempts still failed: the port may be in use or the program may have moved. Retry, or check the crash log and app log.
settings.systemhint: The first option of each follows Windows (light/dark and accent color).
settings.debughint: Logs at DEBUG level and enables DevTools and the status bar.
settings.debughint2: Applied and saved (console window needs a restart)
settings.updatecheckhint: Checks GitHub Releases for a new version after startup. Project information can still be refreshed manually when disabled.
settings.cornerhint: Slider covers the common range; type any larger value in the box (the slider hides beyond its range).
settings.densityhint: Slider covers 0.8–1.4; type any larger value in the box (the slider hides beyond its range).
settings.animhint: Turning this off removes every transition for the most immediate response.
settings.autorestarthint: If the engine (backend) exits unexpectedly it is relaunched automatically.
settings.palettehint: Palette and light/dark mode are independent (each can follow the system or be chosen manually); radius and density apply to every theme.
settings.customhint: Turning on custom colors shows accent/background/panel pickers and hides the preset light-dark and palette selectors.
record.savefail: Failed to save recording settings; configuration was reloaded
record.hint: Multiple backends can be selected. Retention 0 means forever. Hardware information follows the collection frequency.
settings.autostarthint: Pick the registration methods (multi-select); every registration passes --autostart and duplicate launches yield silently to the running instance.
autostart.silenthint: Autostart keeps the app in the tray without opening the window.
autostart.stale: A registration points elsewhere or has stale arguments; save again to repair it.
settings.advthemehint: Fine-grained items: brand title, indicator light, status-bar hover info and name width; changes save automatically.
settings.chipwhint: Names longer than this scroll sideways on hover instead of being cut off.
settings.barhhint: 0 = follow density (default 26px × density); >0 pins the height in px; the sidebar collapse button stays aligned.
settings.listcaphint: Long lists (devices/OSC…) show this many rows; the rest scroll inside the box.
settings.advdraft: Changes apply after saving; confirm to keep, or they revert automatically.
settings.advtimeout: Reverts automatically if not confirmed within 15s
settings.advhint: Advanced options from other tabs, kept in sync with their own pages.
settings.webhint: Note: the --web launch flag starts the Web UI automatically.
settings.brandhint: Top-left title {} template; empty shows the default name. Supports system vars ({BPM}/{CPU_USAGE}/{TIME_LOCAL_HMS}…) and {ping}/{oscRx}/{oscSent}/{oscFail}/{bpm}/{devices}/{connected}/{version}; unknown placeholders render empty.
settings.pathhint: config.json, logs, database, exports and remote accounts live here; static assets (webui / engine DLL) stay next to the program.
settings.pathrestart: Saved - takes effect after a restart
web.hint: Second frontend serves the same UI but adds a local auth layer: user store + sessions (with browser fingerprint) + role/tab whitelist.
web.confighint: 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces; binding any-address as a normal user needs a one-time reservation: netsh http add urlacl url=http://+:port/ user=Users.
web.usershint: admin gets every tab and privileges; user only sees whitelisted tabs (console / API server / Settings / Web excluded by default).
web.passhint: Passwords are hashed locally with PBKDF2-SHA256 (200k iterations + random salt); never stored or echoed in clear text.
web.delhint: Remove user "{name}"? All of their sessions are destroyed too.
web.err.name: Username is required
web.err.failed: Operation failed (the username may already exist)
web.err.lastadmin: Cannot remove: at least one admin must remain
web.portinfo: Local and remote share one listener port; authorization follows the source: loopback = local admin, private = LAN, public = WAN.
web.lanhint: Devices on the same private network (RFC1918/ULA) may sign in; loopback never needs login.
web.wanhint: Public sources may sign in. A port mapped to the internet is reachable worldwide; enable only when needed and always with a strong password.
web.wanconfirm: I understand the risk and want public access
web.wanpass: Set admin password (>=8 chars, letters and digits)
web.wanweak: WAN blocked: the admin password is uninitialized, default, or too weak.
web.boundloopback: Loopback-only bind (LAN/WAN unreachable; needs a URL ACL)
web.initlocal: Create a strong-password administrator on the local Web page before enabling LAN/WAN.
remote.mustchange: Change the default password to continue
remote.initweak: Password must be >=8 chars with letters and digits
remote.title: Second frontend sign in
remote.hint: This page is served over the network; sign in with a local account first.
web.denied: This tab is not in the current remote role whitelist
record.label: Recording
osc.autostarthint: Connect and start OSC pushing when the main program starts
osc.noparams: No inbound OSC parameters yet (check VRChat is running and OSC sends to 127.0.0.1:9001).
osc.pagehint: Overview shows world, pose and avatar data from VRChat; Data lists every address.
osc.worldhint: VRChat's OSC does not expose the world ID; only instance state derived from parameters is shown.
osc.trackinghint: No /tracking/* addresses yet (sent only in VR mode or with full-body tracking).
push.customhint: Send one text/parameter to VRChat etc. (also how a phone sends remotely); the text supports {} variables like {BPM}.
push.floatval: Supports {} variables; rendered then sent as a number
push.previewhint: Rendered live with current system vars, refreshes every second
push.charwarn: Over 134 chars: VRChat caps the ChatBox at 144; excess text may not display. Hint only, sending is not blocked.
vrc.launchhint: Detects the local VRChat install and launches it; falls back to Steam when none is found. Never launches a second copy while running.
dev.autodetecthint: Tries devices by score and keeps the first one reporting heart rate (audio and smart-home devices are skipped).
dev.blockedhint: Blocked devices stay hidden from every list (scan/connect/auto-detect skip them). Unblock them here.
dev.advratehint: Rate at which the device broadcasts advertising packets (scan only)
dev.notifyratehint: Rate at which a connected device pushes heart-rate notifications
dev.rssihint: After connecting, the Bluetooth stack no longer reports advertising RSSI, so it shows —
dev.clickhint: Single click: details · Double click: connect/disconnect
dev.norecords: No history yet (recording must be enabled on the HR page to store samples)
dev.colhint: Drag the header dividers to resize columns (saved automatically)
dev.cfghint: Continuous scan has no time limit; the refresh interval reduces list flicker.
float.fmthint: Text is shown as-is; {bpm}=live heart rate; {img}=background image
logs.exporthint: Exports the current filtered lines to exports/
logs.tracehint: Writes pipe / Web / BLE timing marks to logs/trace.log for hard-to-repro performance issues.
hw.kindhint: expr = arithmetic; concat = substitute {vars} only; regex = first group of the concatenated text; cmd = stdout
api.wshint: Send {"id":1,"cmd":"status"}; replies use type=response, pushes use type=<event>.
api.webhookhint: URL / headers / body support {bpm}, {event} and all system variables.
api.warn: Security: bound to 127.0.0.1 only; with an empty token any local process can call it. Set a token before exposing it.
mon.nodata: No records in this range (enable Recording on the OSC tab first).

about.author: Author
about.ghhint: GitHub data comes from the same-origin backend snapshot; refresh manually, with cached data retained offline.
about.intro: HeartRateMonitor project, release, and update information
toolkit.desc: Local VRChat config, photo, log, cache, game and process tools
toolkit.configdesc: Table-edit VRChat config.json with strict JSON saving.
toolkit.cachedesc: Cache usage analysis; cleaning is disabled while VRChat runs.
toolkit.photosdesc: Manually index photos and search by keywords.
toolkit.processdesc: Live VRChat CPU/RAM readings with history curves.
toolkit.jsonhint: Strict JSON: numeric/boolean fields keep their type; path fields support environment variables.
toolkit.jsonerr: Field type error; check numeric/boolean inputs.
toolkit.author: Author
toolkit.vrrunning: VRChat is running; writes are blocked.
toolkit.cleanhint: Deletes everything inside the cache directory; VRChat must be closed.
toolkit.cleanfail: Cannot preview or clean the cache.
